evaluation_name: Phase 36 Tactical Pitch Mapping & Homography Evaluation
homography_method: OpenCV Planar Homography with RANSAC Landmark Outlier Rejection

operational_safeguards.minimum_landmarks: Requires at least 4 non-collinear pitch landmarks to solve H matrix.
operational_safeguards.degradation_behavior: During camera replays, goal celebrations, or tight close-ups, homography is set to UNMAPPED and 2D pixel coordinates are retained.
operational_safeguards.distortion_bounds: Any projected point yielding negative coordinates or values exceeding 110m x 75m is discarded as an unphysical artifact.
